posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina delighted fans with her May photo dump featuring unseen moments from Vicky Kaushal's birthday, a 'Happy Birthday Papa' cake, and a rare glimpse of baby Vihaan's tiny hands as she read to him.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Imtiaz Ali film Main Vaapas Aaunga clashes with Kangana's movie on June 12. Meanwhile, Sardaar Ji 3 skips India release amid backlash over Pakistani actress Hania Aamir's casting.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia and Sharvari kick off Alpha promotions ahead of its July 3 release — the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film. The duo also championed women's cricket in a viral ICC T20 World Cup campaign.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka confirms six months of shooting remain for SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi with Mahesh Babu, hinting at an Antarctica schedule. She's also set to reprise her role in Hrithik's Krrish 4.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's action thriller King with daughter Suhana Khan is confirmed for Christmas 2026 release. The ₹350 crore film also stars Deepika Padukone and Abhishek Bachchan as the villain.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena and Saif turned heads at the screening of sister Karisma's neo-noir thriller Brown. She's also in talks to reunite with Salman Khan in a Raj & DK superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in the mythological epic Mahavatar, and is wrapping up the period musical Eetha before moving on to her Naagin trilogy.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announced she's expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh but is still filming intense action scenes for King with SRK. A body double will handle stunts in Allu Arjun's Raka.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: After Dhurandhar 2's historic ₹1,800 crore worldwide run, Ranveer's post-apocalyptic thriller Pralay with a ₹300 crore budget begins shooting in August. The couple went viral at a Goa wedding.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya faced online body-shaming after her 2026 Cannes red carpet appearance. Madhuri Dixit came to her defense, calling her an achiever and slamming trolls for judging from their sofas.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika reunites with Allu Arjun in Atlee's sci-fi epic Raka after the Pushpa franchise. She's completed her look test in LA and will play one of the most daring roles of her career.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's production Maa Inti Bangaram adds Gulshan Devaiah for a pivotal role. She's also starring in and producing this Telugu thriller under her banner Tralala Moving Pictures.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's sci-fi spectacle Raka with director Atlee is assembling a massive cast including Deepika, Rashmika, and Janhvi. After Pushpa 2's blockbuster success, expectations are sky-high.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama Peddi opened massive — crossing ₹100 crore worldwide on Day 1, beating Dhurandhar and Pathaan records. AR Rahman's score is earning widespread praise.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR will headline director Trivikram's mythological film about Kartikeya after Allu Arjun departed. He's got four films lined up — War 2 (Aug 14), Dragon, Devara 2, and a Nelson film.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi stars alongside Ram Charan in Peddi, which just opened to massive box office numbers. She's also part of the ensemble cast in Allu Arjun and Atlee's upcoming sci-fi epic Raka.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya graces Filmfare's May-June 2026 cover, opening up about privilege, insecurity, and growth. Her Dharma romantic drama Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya and Call Me Bae Season 2 are both lined up.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara turned heads at the Nita Ambani Cultural Centre's third anniversary event in a stunning pink saree alongside Sidharth Malhotra. She's currently focused on enjoying motherhood with baby Saraayah.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik and Jr NTR's War 2 is confirmed for IMAX release on August 14 and has sealed non-theatrical deals worth ₹225 crore. He's also making his directorial debut with Krrish 4.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai releases today (June 5) — his father David Dhawan's final directorial film. It's a rom-com co-starring Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya released devotional track 'Siddha Bhajo' as an emotional tribute to her father. She's taking The Unstoppable Tour to Auckland and Australia later this month with 16 upcoming concerts.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman's score for Ram Charan's Peddi is earning massive praise — breaking the myth that his films don't work at the box office. He's also co-producing Masoom: The New Generation with Shekhar Kapur.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's farewell film Jananayagan is eyeing a summer release window after Tamil Nadu elections. The ₹500 crore H. Vinoth-directed epic has massive fan anticipation as his final cinematic act.
